reason: Foundational pollinator-identification evidence; no flower-colour manipulation and no A/F/C/P molecular contrast.

citation: Zhou XW, Li JY, Fan Z. Cloning and expression analysis of chalcone isomerase gene cDNA from Camellia nitidissima. Forest Research 25:93-99.
verification_level: peer-reviewed reference chain in Zhou et al. 2017
reason: CHI is shared upstream of A/F/P branch separation and remains within the already represented C. nitidissima developmental background.

citation: Zhou Xingwen. 金花茶花色相关基因的克隆及其功能研究 [Cloning and function research of pigment genes from Camellia nitidissima]. PhD dissertation, Chinese Academy of Forestry.
reason: The thesis is important grey-literature provenance for the same C. nitidissima candidate-gene programme; it is not a distinct evolutionary replicate and no auditable public raw RNA-seq dataset was identified.

citation: Zhou X et al. Functional analyses of a flavonol synthase-like gene from Camellia nitidissima reveal its roles in flavonoid metabolism during floral pigmentation. Journal of Biosciences 38:593-604.
reason: Direct FLS/flavonol functional evidence, already logged as SCR008; same taxon/developmental mechanism background, so it strengthens F feasibility without adding an independence cluster.

citation: Zhou X, Yin H, Zhu Y, Li J. Cloning and Expression Analysis of Flavanone 3-hydroxylase Gene CnF3H from Camellia nitidissima. Molecular Plant Breeding 13:2051-2057.

reason: F3H is upstream of the prespecified module split and the evidence comes from the same C. nitidissima lineage/developmental programme.

citation: Zhou XW, Li JY, Zhu YL. Cloning and Genetic Transformation of CnCHS Gene from Camellia nitidissima. Bulletin of Botanical Research 35(3):327-332.
reason: CnCHS was cloned from petals and transformed into tobacco, but this establishes upstream pathway feasibility rather than a matched directional Camellia A/F/C/P signature or new lineage origin.

citation: Huang B et al. 油茶花青素还原酶基因克隆和体外功能研究 [Cloning and in-vitro functional analysis of anthocyanidin reductase genes from Camellia oleifera]. 茶业通报 40(2):71-76.
reason: CoANR1/2 establish P-axis catalytic feasibility but there is no matched petal-colour contrast, canonical transition direction, or independent recurrence signature.

reason: CnF3'H expression and heterologous function refine flavonoid chemistry in the same C. nitidissima background but F3'H is not one of the frozen A/F/C/P module-defining families and does not add an independent contrast.

citation: Li B et al. Cloning, Subcellular Localization and Expression Analysis of CnbHLH79 Transcription Factor from Camellia nitidissima. Biotechnology Bulletin 39(8):241.
reason: CnbHLH79 expression covaries with petal b* and Qu7G across flowering stages, but it is an upstream regulator in the already represented C. nitidissima developmental cluster rather than a new A/F/C/P replicate.
